snippet.title: Reveal Trailer - Pardon My French Toast
snippet.description:
Be a Toast! Join the Cruise!!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3407360/Pardon_My_French_Toast
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Pardon-My-French-Toast-2840377.html

Pardon My French Toast is a 3D-platformer set in a culinary world. Use your toast abilities to explore dozens of levels and help Jam Session's cruise to stay afloat!

Coming in 2026 on Nintendo Switch and Steam
Early access available NOW on Steam
Try the demo!!
